description: Legacy platform information for backward compatibility with existing HDF documents.

name.description: The name of the platform this was run on.

targetId.description: The id of the target. Example: the name and version of the operating system were not sufficient to identify the platform so a release identifier can additionally be provided like '21H2' for the release version of MS Windows 10.

Platform.description: Platform information such as its name. This is the legacy target representation; see Target for the new polymorphic target system.
